visual_goal: Show the control plane deciding who the tenant is and where it lives, while cells hold tenant data and report usage back.
prompt: A left-to-right illustration. Left: a laptop icon labeled 'Dealer user'. One arrow from it, labeled 'token', into a gate box labeled 'Edge gateway'. Directly above the gateway, a small map-pin box labeled 'Cell map', with one short arrow from 'Edge gateway' up to 'Cell map' labeled 'lookup'. From 'Edge gateway' two separate arrows to the right, each labeled 'tenant context': one into a large rounded container labeled 'Cell EU-A' and one into a large rounded container labeled 'Cell UK'; each container holds a few small generic server and database shapes. Top right, above the two cells only, a teal directory-tree box labeled 'Tenant directory', with exactly two downward arrows, one into each cell, labeled 'hierarchy events'. 'Tenant directory' connects to nothing else; the laptop has only its one arrow to the gateway. Bottom right, below the two cells only, a meter-gauge box labeled 'Meterline', with exactly two arrows down into it, one from each cell, labeled 'usage'. These labels are the only words in the image.
alt: A dealer user's token enters the edge gateway, which looks up the cell map and routes a tenant context to Cell EU-A or Cell UK; the tenant directory sends hierarchy events to both cells, and both report usage to Meterline.

visual_goal: Show Velto as one tenant: legal entities own rooftops, a region groups rooftops without owning them, and people hold memberships at the level where they work.
prompt: A top-down tree illustration occupying the left two-thirds. At the top, a large building-group box labeled 'Velto Mobility Group'. Two solid lines down to two company-document boxes labeled 'Velto Noord B.V.' and 'Velto Vlaanderen NV'. Under 'Velto Noord B.V.', a solid line to a small dealership-building box labeled 'Breda'; under 'Velto Vlaanderen NV', a solid line to a small dealership-building box labeled 'Gent-Zuid'. Under 'Breda', a solid line to a small desk box labeled 'Used sales'. To the left of 'Breda', a dashed orange outline box labeled 'Hub Noord-Brabant' with a dashed arrow to 'Breda'. In the right third, three generic unlabeled person figures, one above another. The top person, level with 'Velto Mobility Group', has one straight horizontal blue arrow pointing left into 'Velto Mobility Group', labeled 'group role'. The bottom person, level with 'Used sales', has one straight horizontal green arrow pointing left into 'Used sales', labeled 'staff role'. The middle person has a small hourglass and one dashed orange arrow going up-left into 'Velto Mobility Group', labeled 'expires 31 Dec'. Each person has exactly one arrow. These eleven labels are the only words in the image.
alt: Velto Mobility Group at the top, with two legal entities that each own a rooftop, Breda and Gent-Zuid; a dashed hub groups Breda; Breda has a used-sales department; people hold a group role, a staff role and an expiring external membership.

visual_goal: Show a rooftop's lifecycle with transfer and closure as explicit states.
prompt: A simple state map of six rounded tiles. Far left: grey 'Onboarding'. Center: large green 'Active'. Above 'Active': orange 'Suspended'. Right of 'Active': teal 'Transferring'. Below 'Active': amber 'Closing'. Right of 'Closing': dark grey 'Closed'. Exactly seven arrows: one from 'Onboarding' to 'Active' labeled 'go-live'; one from 'Active' up to 'Suspended' labeled 'unpaid'; one from 'Suspended' back down to 'Active' labeled 'resolved'; one from 'Active' to 'Transferring' labeled 'sale agreed'; one curved arrow from 'Transferring' back to 'Active' labeled 're-parented'; one from 'Active' down to 'Closing' labeled 'rooftop closed'; one from 'Closing' to 'Closed' labeled 'successor set'. These thirteen labels are the only words in the image.
alt: Rooftop states: Onboarding goes live to Active; Active can be Suspended and resolved, move to Transferring and be re-parented back to Active, or move to Closing and then Closed once a successor is set.
